page.layout: One column of Hebrew dictionary entries with Latin glosses, centred on the page; page number at top left (227) and Hebrew letter head at top centre; signature "K 6" at foot left. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: עָוֶל עָוֹל m. עוֹלָה f. Iniquitas.
עַוְלָתָה עוֹלָה f. Summa iniquitas, Nequitia, cum geminato signo fœmineo, quo aucta significatio indicari solet: plur. עַוְלוֹת Iniquitates.
עוֹנָה עוֹן f. Habitatio, vel juxta quosdam Tempus. Hebraei de officio maritali erga conjugem interpretantur: plur. עֹנוֹת.
עוֹן Tempora observare, & ex illis futura praedicere, juxta quosdam: Vide עַיִן.
מָעוֹן m. מְעוֹנָה f. Habitaculum: plurale, מְעֹונוֹת מְעוֹנִים.
עוּף Volare. Adv. Avo. Evo. Invo. Pihel עוֹפֵף Idem, vel Volare fecit. Hiphil הֶעִיף Idem. Hophal הוּעַף Volare factus vel jussus. Hithpahel הִתְעוֹפֵף Advolavit.
עוֹף m. Avis, Volucris, Volatile. Chald. idem.
עֲיפָה f. Obscuritas: עֲיפָתָה Obscuritas maxima, densissima.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-type vocalisation is reproduced approximately; the scan is faint in the lower entries and some vowel points are uncertain. Show-through from the reverse side is present and omitted.
